Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/single-file-core/-/single-file-core-1.6.19.tgz
Package integrity: sha512-eWcAxr9rD1jaTPLrVxAgZdKXIZ65k/oz+tSn5Y5x3S946ijoIC7Qn1L2qE5y7p5BtLKvQCb4bqQXnee9CWYrTA==

The complete, unmodified upstream JavaScript source used as build input is
included in vendor/single-file-core/ in the Firefox MCP source package, outside
the add-on runtime. Its LICENSE and original third-party notices are retained
there. The full upstream license is also included in the add-on as
extension/vendor/single-file-LICENSE.txt, alongside this notice and the bundle.

The bundle is generated from those originals and the reviewable transformations
in scripts/single-file-build.mjs; it is not an unmodified upstream file. The build
removes unsupported compression/ZIP workers, infobar, noscript restoration and
Chromium-specific DOM code. Unsupported upstream options fail closed, and
loadOptionsFromPage is disabled so a page cannot override fixed export options.
The supported HTML capture features remain included. Notices for included code
are retained in the bundle. Original source files are not modified by the build.
After npm ci, reproduce it with: node scripts/build-html-vendor.mjs
The build uses the exact esbuild version pinned in package-lock.json.

The extension's SingleFile integration, including html-export.js, is distributed
under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Its corresponding source, original vendor sources and
reproducible build instructions are included in the Firefox MCP source package.
SingleFile has no runtime download or remote service dependency in this
integration.
